title: Stencil-internal execution-class physical tangent estimator
question: Can a tangent estimator remain available and stable across the frozen real-SWAP boundary states when execution consistency is enforced inside the derivative stencil rather than by exact equality to the center trial?
boundary_states: Reuse the same eight frozen negative/positive boundary states from G09/G09B.

execution_class.readiness: participant status 0, raw result_status 0, completed true, candidate_ready true
execution_class.equality: all listed fields exactly equal within one candidate stencil

candidate_generation: At every fixed d evaluate center, h±d and h±2d from the immutable accepted origin.
CENTRAL candidate: h-d and h+d are both ready and share one execution class with each other. Center class is irrelevant because q(h) is not used by the central secant.
BACKWARD candidate: center, h-d and h-2d are all ready and share one execution class.
FORWARD candidate: center, h+d and h+2d are all ready and share one execution class.
At one scale choose CENTRAL first, otherwise BACKWARD, otherwise FORWARD. Require finite negative slope.
multiscale_acceptance: Do not accept a single-scale candidate.
Scan the fixed ladder from coarse to fine and find the first adjacent pair of scales that both yield candidates and whose slopes differ by <=5% relative to their larger magnitude.
Return the coarser member of that first qualifying adjacent pair.
Candidate mode may differ across the two scales; each candidate must independently satisfy its stencil-internal execution-class rule.
If no adjacent pair qualifies, classify TANGENT_UNAVAILABLE.

required_estimator_outcomes: All eight frozen boundary states must produce E3 AVAILABLE with <=5% adjacent-scale agreement.
C1_LOW_FORCING negative dh=-5e-6 must be recovered by a CENTRAL candidate pair whose ± probes share a class even though the center does not.
C2_HIGH_FORCING negative dh=-5e-6 must remain recoverable without using status-6 probes.
C3_LONG_HIGH positive dh=+2e-6 must reject central stencils that cross the one-substep/two-substep branch and use a class-consistent alternative.
groundwater_regimes: Reuse all three frozen G08 groundwater regimes and independently remeasure q_gw(H) in each replay.
policies: P1-E3 raw physical Newton with E3 re-estimated at every outer iterate.
P4-E3 same E3 tangent plus fixed factor-1/2 backtracking on participant inadmissibility or coupled-residual increase.
hard_rules: Every SWAP probe and policy candidate is trial->evaluate->discard; accepted state and ledger remain immutable.
Do not alter SWAP tolerances, retry budget or temporal-substep policy.
Do not change G09/G09B historical results or thresholds.
No production HCOF/RHS or coupling-source changes.
G09D may qualify E3 only as a research tangent estimator; production admission and computational-cost qualification remain separate.
